project.title: Magicians and Charlatans
project.description: Carcassone expansion by Pennautier introducing mystical and deceptive elements.
project.longDescription: Magicians and Charlatans, a Pennautier expansion for Carcassone, introduces mystical themes and deceptive play mechanics, adding new layers of strategy to the beloved board game.
